headline: Waymo conquered city streets — why does it keep stumbling on freeways?
summary: A driverless Waymo attempted to overtake highway patrol cars during a traffic break. The incident on Interstate 280 highlights the company's struggles with freeway protocols. Video evidence shows a moving violation by the robotaxi.

headline: X is finally getting its first parental controls
summary: X is rolling out new parental controls for teen accounts. Parents can monitor screen time, set limits, and approve followers. These features aim to give guardians more oversight on the platform.

headline: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users’ chats
summary: A coalition of 42 state attorneys general is opposing Character.AI's plan to sell user data. The company is navigating Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings. AGs accuse the company of planning to auction off 21 million private chat histories.

headline: Now Google’s Familiar Faces AI feature works on Walmart’s $35 smart home camera too
summary: Google's Familiar Faces AI now supports Walmart's budget Onn smart cameras. The feature helps recognize people around your house. A Google Home Premium subscription is required for access.

headline: The PlayStation 5 Pro Console Is Going In and Out of Stock at Amazon
summary: The PlayStation 5 Pro console is experiencing fluctuating stock levels on Amazon. Securing one requires both perseverance and luck from shoppers. Availability comes and goes rapidly.

headline: New Model Apple iPad Tablets Are on Sale for Black Friday, Including the iPad Mini Released This Month
summary: New model Apple iPad tablets are featured in Black Friday sales. Deals include the recently released iPad Mini. These sales largely counteract earlier price increases.

headline: The Rings of Power Season 3 Ending Explained With Showrunners J. D. Payne and Patrick McKay
summary: Showrunners J. D. Payne and Patrick McKay explain The Rings of Power Season 3 ending. They break down all key events from the finale. The discussion also covers expectations for the next season.

headline: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth Director David Fincher Sparks Backlash for 'Wildly Dystopian' Vision of AI-powered Filmmaking
summary: Director David Fincher faces backlash for his 'dystopian' vision of AI filmmaking. Controversy arose amid AI use in Netflix's 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth'. Critics question the implications of his perspective on cinematic AI.

headline: UK net migration at lowest level since 1997 as asylum claims also fall
summary: UK net migration recorded its lowest level since 1997, excluding pandemic years. Figures show 77,000 net migrants in the year to June. Asylum claims have also seen a significant decrease.

headline: German boat dealer suspected of supplying Channel smuggling gangs, BBC finds
summary: A German boat dealer is suspected of supplying vessels to Channel smuggling gangs. Nearly a third of early 2026 crossings allegedly involved boats or engines from his firm. A BBC investigation uncovered the link to illegal crossings.

headline: Watch: BBC confronts German man suspected of supplying migrant gangs with small boats
summary: BBC confronts Marvin Reuter, suspected of supplying boats to migrant gangs. His firm's vessels were allegedly used in nearly a third of early 2026 Channel crossings. The report details the confrontation regarding the suspected involvement.

headline: UK reservists contacted as 'threat environment' rises, Streeting says
summary: UK reservists have been contacted amid a rising 'threat environment'. This follows reports of letters asking reservists to prepare for call-up. Wes Streeting confirmed the communications regarding potential deployment.
